name: Bitbucket
description: Bitbucket Cloud skill and personal Bitbucket logins: each signed-in person connects their own account, and commands in their sessions use it.

gitIdentity.description: Set the Git author and committer of a session's commands to the session owner's Bitbucket account.

execLogin.description: Give the commands in a person's sessions their Bitbucket login. Off, agents cannot push or write pull requests, and publishing goes only through the gateway's confirmed publish.

controlUiTab.description: Show a Bitbucket tab in the Control UI sidebar.
